journey.name: spending confirm amount change
journey.description:
Verifies that a transfer to spending never pays more than Spending Confirm shows. The screen prices the network fee to the Spark deposit address when it opens, whenever the amount or the speed changes, every minute while it stays open, and again at the swipe. A swipe whose fresh price costs the same or less pays at once; one that costs more pays nothing: the screen shows the new amounts, a "Fees changed" toast explains the increase, and the next swipe pays them.
This journey covers the no-higher path and the re-quote after an amount change. A larger UTXO confirms while Spending Confirm is open, so the transfer is priced at the swipe against a changed wallet. Coin selection may keep two inputs (150 000 + 150 000, or 150 000 + 500 000) at the same fee, or spend the new UTXO alone at a lower fee; either way the fresh price costs no more than the one shown, so the swipe pays at once. The higher-total path (the "Fees changed" toast) needs fee rates to rise between the quote and the swipe, which is not a listed capability.
Precondition: a freshly onboarded Debug build on the staging regtest backend with Spark connected, launched with SPARK_CHAIN_SERVICE_URL set to that regtest's Esplora URL (otherwise the transfer shows the Transfer Unavailable sheet), no spending balance and exactly two confirmed on-chain UTXOs of 150 000 sats each (two ../bitkit-android/lsp deposits to the wallet's savings address, each followed by a mine). Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap Receive (id "Receive"), tap the "Savings" receive tab if one is shown, tap "Show Details" (id "ShowDetails"), read the address from id "ReceiveOnchainAddress", then close the sheet to return to the home screen
Tap the Savings balance card (id "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (id "TransferToSpending")
If the spending intro appears, tap "Get Started" (id "SpendingIntro-button")
Enter 100 000 on the number pad (ids "N1", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0", "N0") and tap "Continue" (id "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify the confirm screen is visible (id "SpendingConfirm"), wait until its network fee is shown, and note "To spending" and "Total"
Tap back (id "NavigationBack"), delete one digit (id "NRemove") and enter "N2", "N0" so the amount reads 200 000, then tap "Continue" (id "SpendingAmountContinue")
Verify "To spending" and "Total" now reflect 200 000 rather than the noted values, and wait until the network fee is shown
Note the amounts under "Network fees" and "Total"
Run in one command: ../bitkit-android/lsp POST /regtest/chain/deposit '{"address":"<savings addr>","amountSat":500000}' && ../bitkit-android/lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":1}'
Wait 30s for the wallet to sync the new UTXO
If the received sheet (id "ReceivedTransaction") is visible, tap its button (id "ReceivedTransactionButton")
Verify the confirm screen is visible; "Network fees" and "Total" may already show lower amounts than noted
Swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Verify no "Fees changed" toast appears and the setting up screen (id "LightningSettingUp") opens within 30s
